AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator lookup record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AppSettings.title: AppSettings
AppSettings.description: Global application settings, license system toggle, and in-app notification/promotion configuration.

licenseSystemEnabled.description: Whether the license key gate is active on app launch.

supportNumber.description: Support phone/WhatsApp number displayed on the license activation screen.

notificationEnabled.description: Whether the in-app broadcast notification/promotion banner and modal are active.

notificationTitle.description: Headline title for the in-app notification or promotion.

notificationMessage.description: Detailed message body for the in-app notification or promotion.

promoBadge.description: Badge text displayed on the promotion modal (e.g., SPECIAL OFFER, NOTICE).

promoButtonText.description: Action button label on the promotion modal.

promoActionUrl.description: Optional external URL opened when the user taps the promotion action button.

setupVideoEnabled.description: Whether the in-app YouTube setup video guide button and popup player are enabled.

setupVideoTitle.description: Custom display title for the setup video guide button and popup.

setupVideoUrl.description: YouTube video URL for the app setup tutorial.

updatedBy.description: UID of the administrator who last updated the settings.

LicensePackage.title: LicensePackage
LicensePackage.description: Subscription/license package plan displayed to users on the license activation screen.

durationDays.description: Validity duration of the package in days.

active.description: Whether the package is publicly visible.

maxVideoDuration.description: Optional limit value displayed on the package card.

description.description: Optional feature description label shown on the package card.

createdBy.description: UID of the administrator who created the package.

LicenseKey.title: LicenseKey
LicenseKey.description: License key record binding a generated or custom key to a specific device and expiration period.

days.description: Duration in days granted upon activation.

price.description: Price in BDT associated with this license key.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the license key.

adminEmail.description: Authorized super admin email owning this license registry.

createdBy.description: UID of the administrator who created the license.

deviceId.description: Hardware device identifier bound to this license upon activation.

activatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who activated or transferred this license.

activatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the license was activated.

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the license expires.

lastTransferredAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the license was last transferred.

note.description: Optional admin note or customer identifier.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Trusted administrator lookup table keyed by UID.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Global application settings, license system toggle, and in-app notification/promo config.

/packages/{packageId}.description: Publicly selectable license packages managed by the super administrator.

/licenses/{licenseId}.description: License keys created and controlled by the super administrator and activated by devices.
